name: TableBank: Table Benchmark for Detection and Recognition
description: TableBank is a benchmark dataset for image-based table detection and table recognition. It contains 417,236 high-quality document images with table bounding boxes and corresponding markdown / LaTeX / Word table structure markup crawled from arXiv and Word documents.
